verdict.rationale: Numeral ships an official MCP server that exposes nexus, filings, and registrations as agent-callable tools, including per-jurisdiction nexus status with thresholds and current sales. However, agents authenticate with the existing full secret API key, not scoped credentials, and the evidence never shows accrued liability or write actions on that posture. Missing for 10: scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents, explicit accrued-liability data, documented ability to act on (not just read) registrations and filings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my tax posture — nexus status, registrations, accrued liability, upcoming filings — and act on it through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: The Numeral MCP server is a single HTTPS endpoint that exposes your Numeral account — nexus, filings, registrations, transactions, sales, products, and exemption certificates — as tools an AI agent can call directly.
The account's current nexus position per jurisdiction: whether nexus has been triggered (economic and/or physical), the economic thresholds with current sales and transaction counts
any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or your own agent built on an LLM SDK) can connect with your existing Numeral secret API key
